# TUNK

> TUNK is an Istanbul-based architecture and design studio working at the intersection of space, material and experience. Its practice spans architecture, interiors, exhibition design, installation, lighting and product, with each project conceived as a spatial system of its own rather than a style to be applied.

Its approach brings together architectural thinking, artistic research and material experimentation, with light, sound and technology used as working materials. The practice studies how materials, industrial processes and technical systems shape the way a space is experienced, and turns that research into built work.

Commissions and the studio's own self-initiated projects are approached in the same way: each begins with a close reading of its context and is followed through its processes down to the smallest detail. This analytical way of working is what gives the results their precision, whether the outcome is a space, an object or a strategy.

Idea and making are developed together. For each project TUNK devises its own production methods, working with Istanbul's metal, glass and craft workshops and with manufacturers from design and prototyping through to fabrication, so that concept, technical detail and physical result are held to the same standard.

The work ranges from experimental and immersive installations and site-specific interventions to museum and gallery exhibitions at the Pera Museum, Istanbul Modern, Akbank Sanat and the AKM Opera House; retail environments such as the Pneuma Flagship Store for Parfumlab, awarded Silver in the FRAME Awards 2026 monthly jury evaluation; residential, restaurant and interior projects; and custom lighting and collectible design, represented by Adorno Design and shown at Milan Design Week and 3 Days of Design. Projects have been published by Frame, ArchDaily, Designboom, Dezeen and Design Milk.

The studio was founded in 2014 by architect Buşra Tunç, who leads its creative direction. TUNK works with brands, cultural institutions, developers, artists and private clients looking for a space made specifically for them. For a site, a brief or an idea that needs a spatial form: tunc@tunkstudio.com

Contact: tunc@tunkstudio.com · Galata, Istanbul, Türkiye

## Disciplines

- Architecture & Interiors: Residential · office · commercial · restaurant & hospitality
- Retail & Brand Spaces: Flagship stores · kiosks · window displays · display systems
- Brand Collaborations & Creative Direction: Concept · creative direction · brand experiences & activations
- Exhibition Design: Museum & gallery exhibitions
- Immersive, Light & Audiovisual Installations: Immersive spatial experiences · light, sound & audiovisual installations · site-specific, permanent & temporary works · public art
- Set & Atmosphere Design: Sets and atmospheres for product & studio photography
- Product & Lighting: Custom furniture, lighting & collectible design

## Projects

- [POSTANE](https://tunkstudio.com/work/postane): Lighting for the whole of Postane, the restored Old British Post Office in Galata, and the interiors of its two fair-trade shops, designed from what the building revealed during restoration. (Interior & Lighting, Galata, Istanbul, 2021, Türkiye Mimarlık Yıllığı 2021 (Turkey Architecture Yearbook), selected project)
- [THE ROOM WITH FORTY DOORS](https://tunkstudio.com/work/40-kapili-oda): An immersive installation reinterpreting Ottoman architectural elements. (Immersive Exhibition, Istanbul, 2022)
- [RE/FRAMING LOUIS KAHN](https://tunkstudio.com/work/louis-kahn): A spatial video installation for the exhibition Re/Framing Louis Kahn at the Pera Museum, forming spatial photographs of Kahn's buildings. (Spatial Video Installation, Pera Museum, Istanbul, 2017)
- [PARAJANOV WITH SARKIS](https://tunkstudio.com/work/parajanov): The exhibition begins with Sergei Parajanov's own words: "They didn't give me the opportunity to make a cinema, so I made a collage, collage is a compressed film…" It sets out to make his world of images visible by imitating it. (Exhibition Architecture, Pera Museum, Istanbul, 2018)
- [Mitto](https://tunkstudio.com/work/mitto): A commercial interior with a custom furniture collection designed for the space. (Commercial Interior, Istanbul, 2022)
- [Remix](https://tunkstudio.com/work/remix): A multi-sensory exhibition architecture. Forthcoming. (Exhibition, Istanbul, 2019)
- [Moda](https://tunkstudio.com/work/moda): Interior for an apartment in Moda, on Istanbul's Asian shore. (Residential Interior, Moda, Istanbul, 2017)
- [CAGAN](https://tunkstudio.com/work/cagan): An office interior in Istanbul with a custom furniture programme. (Office Interior, Istanbul, 2020)
- [Oculus](https://tunkstudio.com/work/oculus): A site-specific audio-visual performance in the Single-Dome Hall of Tophane-i Amire, where an inverted metal dome answers the historic one. (Installation · Performance, Tophane-i Amire, Istanbul, 2016)
- [Galata Apt](https://tunkstudio.com/work/galata-ormanci): Interior for an apartment in a historic Galata block. (Residential Interior, Galata, Istanbul, 2025)
- [SUBMARINE](https://tunkstudio.com/work/submarine): A house set into an olive grove at Gökçeovacık, above Göcek on the Aegean coast. (Residential, Göcek, Muğla, 2020)
- [Gaziantep House](https://tunkstudio.com/work/gaziantep): A residence in Karapınar, Gaziantep. (Residential, Karapınar, Gaziantep, 2022)
- [Sazlı House](https://tunkstudio.com/work/sazli): A house in Sazlı, on the Çanakkale coast. (Residential, Sazlı, Çanakkale, 2023)
- [Oregon](https://tunkstudio.com/work/oregon): An office interior with a custom furniture collection. (Office Interior, Istanbul, 2021)
- [Cemiyet](https://tunkstudio.com/work/cemiyet): A commercial interior in Istanbul. (Commercial Interior, Istanbul, 2018)
- [WEAVING THE STRUCTURE](https://tunkstudio.com/work/hali-atolyesi): A new spatial system for the carpet-weaving atelier of the Painting Department at Mimar Sinan Fine Arts University, in which the structure itself is woven. (Education Interior, Fındıklı, Istanbul, 2022, Türkiye Mimarlık Yıllığı 2022 (Turkey Architecture Yearbook), selected project)
- [PNEUMA FLAGSHIP STORE](https://tunkstudio.com/work/parfumlab-pneuma): A flagship perfume store for Parfumlab in Istanbul, built on the logic of the pneumatic tube: the hidden network that carries samples through hospitals, made into the visible system of the space. (Retail Design, Istanbul, 2026, FRAME Awards 2026 · Monthly Jury Evaluation · Silver, Single-Brand Store)
- [PNEUMA II](https://tunkstudio.com/work/pneuma-ii): A Parfumlab store in Mersin, built on the pneumatic display system. (Retail Design, Mersin, 2025)
- [PNEUMA I KIOSK](https://tunkstudio.com/work/pneuma-kiosk): A repeatable kiosk format for Parfumlab that carries the pneumatic language of the PNEUMA flagship store into shopping-mall concourses, built in three footprints. (Retail Design, Ankara, Istanbul, 2025–2026)
- [PNEUMA DISPLAY](https://tunkstudio.com/work/parfumlab-atlantis): A Parfumlab store: Atlantis. (Retail Design, Istanbul, 2026)
- [A SPACE OF INSIGHT](https://tunkstudio.com/work/akbank-30): Exhibition architecture for the 30th edition of Akbank's Contemporary Artists programme. (Exhibition Architecture, Akbank Sanat, Istanbul, 2023)
- [SELECTED MOMENTS](https://tunkstudio.com/work/sakir-eczacibasi): Exhibition architecture for a Şakir Eczacıbaşı exhibition. (Exhibition Architecture, Istanbul, N/A)
- [Samih Rıfat “Much Is to Be Done”](https://tunkstudio.com/work/samih-rifat): A non-linear spatial system for Samih Rifat's multidisciplinary archive, spanning photography, film, writing and design, staged as an intellectual topography rather than a chronological retrospective. (Exhibition Architecture, Pera Museum, Istanbul, 2025)
- [INVISIBLE MONUMENTS](https://tunkstudio.com/work/gorunmeyen-anitlar): "Chimneys, often overlooked and invisible to most, embody for me notions of change, progress, architectural intention and environmental awareness," says photographer Eren İnönü of the industrial structures at the centre of this exhibition. (Exhibition Architecture, FMV Galeri Işık, Nişantaşı, Istanbul, 2025)
- [Liminal](https://tunkstudio.com/work/liminal): A custom lighting design. (Lighting Design, N/A)
- [SKINS](https://tunkstudio.com/work/skins): Installation design for Skins, Kerem Ozan Bayraktar's series of digitally rendered portraits of plants, animals and objects: a freestanding steel grid that holds each being in its own box, like a specimen in a collection. (Installation Design, Sanatorium · Istanbul Modern, Istanbul, 2019)
- [INSTRUCTIONS](https://tunkstudio.com/work/yonergeler): Installation design: Instructions. (Installation, Istanbul, 2019)
- [The Painter](https://tunkstudio.com/work/paintstore): A painter's shop rebuilt inside a gallery: a demountable construction for Yağız Özgen's solo exhibition Boyacı (Painter) at Sanatorium, Istanbul, in which the structure itself performs. (Installation, Sanatorium, Istanbul, 2023)
- [Maslak Venue](https://tunkstudio.com/work/maslak-venue): A permanent installation for a night club in Maslak. (Permanent Installation, Maslak, Istanbul, N/A)
- [HELICAL](https://tunkstudio.com/work/pana-helical): A permanent helical installation, with Pana Yapı. (Permanent Installation, Istanbul, N/A)
- [OID](https://tunkstudio.com/work/kohenler-oid): A permanent installation. (Permanent Installation, Istanbul, N/A)
- [Kongre Merkezi](https://tunkstudio.com/work/kongre-merkezi): A temporary, event-based installation for a congress centre. (Temporary Installation, Istanbul, N/A)
- [TERSANE](https://tunkstudio.com/work/tersane-duvar): An unrealised proposal for a wall at the Tersane site. (Proposal · Unrealised, Istanbul, N/A)
- [OZDILEK](https://tunkstudio.com/work/ozdilek): An unrealised proposal for Özdilek. (Proposal · Unrealised, N/A)
